prompt: Build a product listing scraper, run as `sh scrape.sh URL`. If dependencies are needed, provide a setup.sh at the root that installs them. Each page lists products as elements with class product, each containing an element with class name and one with class price formatted like $12.00. Follow the pagination link a[rel=next] (relative URLs allowed) until there is none. Print to stdout one JSON array of {"name","price_cents"} in page order, with HTML entities in names decoded.

hidden.run: if [ -f setup.sh ]; then sh setup.sh; fi; python3 tests_hidden/test_qs.py
